title: Direct online neural weight-space edits without a symbolic compiler under unfamiliar XOR/high-order physics

parent.finding: WSP67 constructed real 8->H->13->5 weights using a symbolic <=2-literal compiler, achieved 405/512 and 97 unseen, tied independent symbolic control; previous SGD neural control unconverged in 8/8 worlds. Focused/G29 PASS Linux Windows, full inherited regression in progress. This result will not be relabeled or retuned.

question: Can a fixed, generic neural representation acquire unfamiliar causal physics by modifying its real readout weights directly after every observation, with no symbolic candidate enumeration or source-aligned rule compiler; preserve correct learned predictions after subsequent edits; and match an independently converged batch-trained neural readout using equal data?
hypothesis: Online regularized least-squares rank-one edits to actual neural readout weights will transfer some causal behavior to never-observed physical transitions and two-action compositions, preserve >=90% previous confident-correct predictions, and converge to the same numerical optimum as a separately implemented batch-trained fixed-feature neural network. It may be worse than strong symbolic or decision-tree controls; no neural superiority expected without observed evidence.

source.families: 4 worlds each of XOR/parity conditionals, triple-AND conditionals, and mixed parity-plus-negated-conjunction coupled effects. Four visible binary sensors, four unknown shuffled physical action channels and sensor roles. Deliberately contains XOR/high-order conjunctions outside WSP67's given single <=2-literal conjunction-per-bit rule class. This is still designed synthetic binary physics, not unrestricted natural-world transfer.
source.training: Exactly one uninterrupted no-reset 96-action seeded-random physical trajectory/world, common public experience rows to all methods. Snapshot first Stage A 48 actions, then incremental Stage B +48 with no reset. No arbitrary-state source queries or hidden physics to learners.
source.test: All 12×16×4=768 source state/action physical outcomes evaluated AFTER training, split by whether the particular (state,action) was ever charged during training. Also 32 independent heldout two-action composition tasks/world =384. Source is evaluator-only.
source.time: Measure CPU+wall and memory/snapshot for actual acquisition, both training and evaluation, plus batch/decision-tree controls. Matched physical actions are not matched compute.

direct_writer.network: Fixed random 8->32 ReLU feature bank plus deterministic raw sensor/action skip connections and bias, with 41-dimensional neural readout to four continuous sensor bits. The 8->32 feature weights are sampled with one preregistered source-independent seed; no hand-coded source predicate, symbolic compiler, causal rule enumeration, or hidden action bit role. Real neural W_readout updated after each actual charged consequence.
direct_writer.algorithm: Recursive regularized least squares (Sherman-Morrison) for all four readout outputs; ridge lambda=0.5, initial weights zero, initial inverse covariance=2I, fixed feature map seed 68182026, direct weight edits use only state/action/next-state training observations. Every observation triggers a weight edit. No gradients, source import or lookup in neural prediction.
direct_writer.confidence: Output nearest sensor bit after threshold at 0.5, but only confident when all four raw bit margins to 0.5 are >=0.27 and posterior feature leverage phi^T P phi <=2.0, using learned inverse covariance. Abstain otherwise. Confidence thresholds fixed before any source outcomes; forced predictions and raw residuals reported independently.
direct_writer.retention: Snapshot only fixed feature parameters, edited readout weight matrix and learned inverse covariance (not evidence/source), tamper-check SHA256, restore prediction bit parity. Stage A vs Stage B compare previously confident-correct physical queries, changed weights and no source-derived rebuilding.

controls: Independently implemented converged batch ridge optimizer over EXACT SAME fixed random neural feature map, lambda and all same charged evidence. Separate Cholesky source and fixed optimality residual criterion; this is conventional fully optimized fixed-feature neural readout, NOT end-to-end trained MLP. It is expected to tie the online direct writer mathematically and should be labeled that way.

Independently implemented fully fitted depth-up-to-4 decision tree over public binary sensor input and action, same charged evidence; report train exact, heldout correct and wrong (not necessarily confident-safe).
Identical-evidence exact state/action lookup with abstention on unknown; strongest memory control with identical source/actions.
Frozen WSP67 independent symbolic compiler out-of-class diagnostic: explicitly report any inconsistency/rejection instead of using it to tune WSP68.
Ablate direct neural readout (zero matrix) and covariance-based confidence to verify nontrivial learned parameter importance.
primary: SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if across all 12 worlds Stage B (A) >=40 correct confident physical predictions at genuine previously-unobserved state/action pairs, (B) >=160 correct confident physical predictions over all 768 audits and >=25 MORE than equal-evidence exact lookup, (C) <=16 confidently wrong physical outcomes over all 768, (D) >=96/384 two-action compositions exact with both direct neural steps confident, (E) >=90% retention of Stage A previously confident-correct physical cases after Stage B, (F) at least 10/12 worlds have nonzero changed actual neural readout parameters and all 12 cold-restored weight-only snapshots have exact raw predictions plus confidence parity and tamper rejection, (G) independently batch-trained same-feature neural readout has numerical optimum residual ||(lambda I+X^TX)W-X^TY||_infinity <=1e-7 AND agrees with online Stage B learned readout to max absolute coefficient difference <=2e-6 in all 12 worlds. Otherwise SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; even signal does NOT prove neural superiority.
secondary: Forced and confident accuracy/false confidence/abstention, train residuals, genuinely unobserved source physical outcomes vs direct lookup
Independent decision-tree correctness and confidence errors, trained gradient baseline convergence status if available, batch ridge optimum cost and same-input tied predictions
Out-of-WSP67 symbolic prior rejection counts; do not call a rejecting comparator a weaker trained baseline
Stage A to B edits/retention/cold restore, rank/leverages and stored learned weight bytes, neuron count, hidden feature map fixed seed
Source/test/charged evidence SHA256; Linux/Windows deterministic science counts, latency/whole CPU and all applied physical actions
limitations: Fixed random features and linear readout are a very strong and limited architecture; equal-batch ridge equivalence tests engineering correctness, not the superiority of direct edits.
Source remains a designed four-bit physics family and test exposures from exhaustive evaluator calls; not human language, self-generated goals or open-world representation invention.

No fully optimized end-to-end gradient-trained MLP is provided by the batch ridge control. An independent trained full neural MLP with adequate convergence remains required before claiming superiority over conventional neural training.
Output uncertainty is heuristic margins+ridge leverage, not a proven safe confidence bound. Wrong-confidence must be counted, never dismissed.
Even fully meeting this synthetic prereg is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS or evidence of general intelligence.
stop: Freeze source seeds, physics classes, train actions, feature map seed/dim, lambda, calibration thresholds, baselines and success criteria BEFORE creating source or learner code and outcomes.
If scientific gate misses, report negative unchanged; mechanical faults can be repaired only without modifying frozen scientific semantics, else new prereg experiment.
Keep original WSP67 evidence unchanged, no merge/promotion/DEV/PRIMARY scientific first-use.
Final focused Linux+Windows, exact-source G29 and mandatory inherited full regression at exact candidate SHA before engineering closure.
